NETHERW.EXE (code file = VA + 0x24800): CastCastleProjectile_66B30's upgrade flight @0x66B73-0x66BAA (file 0x8B373) and sub_66D00's create flight @0x66DEB-0x66E17 (file 0x8B5EB); EF:58819-24 and EF:58946-53 agree.
